summary.text: Rob Ruszkowski is an independent candidate for Georgia's 14th Congressional District and a certified write-in candidate: his name is on the Georgia Secretary of State's list of certified write-in candidates for U.S. House District 14 and is not printed on the ballot.
An entrepreneur, he says he founded Hi-Tech Paging Inc. in Atlanta in 1991.

paragraphs.text: Ruszkowski was born in Plainview, New York, and graduated from Plainview Old Bethpage High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in finance from Hofstra University in 1988.
He has worked as an entrepreneur and an outreach coordinator; in his Ballotpedia survey he says he grew Hi-Tech Paging to five locations in Gwinnett County.
Ruszkowski says he cared for his parents during their final years, from 2005 to 2018, and describes himself as a member of the Gaia Knights Movement.
He ran as an independent in the March 10, 2026 special election for this seat and, according to Ballotpedia, is a write-in candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
